items.title: Jasper Taylor Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: I know I studied with him, studied drums with him. Jimmy took Zillophone and Tiffany from Russick. He studied with straight and many other drummers that I had.

ctx.x: Well, I was going to ask you a little bit about Jimmy Bertrand. I know he didn't come from New Orleans, and I've never talked to him. Do you know where he came from? Is he from Chicago, native here?
Well, Bertrand, I think the family. I think he didn't, I think he was from New Orleans. I thought they might have come down. Bertrand, yeah, yeah, we're French.
